capture_source: live capture 2026-11-08, lab with two SAProuter 40.7 instances on one host (SNC between them) and an S/4HANA gateway behind them. NI_ROUTE sent by the NW RFC SDK (pyrfc) for route /H/127.0.0.1/S/3391/H/127.0.0.1/S/3392/P/pwone. The first router's permission table requires password 'pwone' for connections to the second router; it accepted the route (NI_PONG) and the call completed. A run with the password on the first entry instead was refused with -94.
sanitised: destination address replaced by 198.51.100.7 (TEST-NET-2), byte length preserved. No NI length prefix. 'pwone' is a lab value.
notes: A /P/ value belongs to the /H/ entry before it and is checked by the router that connects TO that entry.
